question: The 4th KIO National Karate Championship (Senior, U-21 & Para) held in March 2025 took place in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **4th KIO National Karate Championship** is a prestigious event organized by the **Karate India Organization (KIO)**, which is the governing body for Karate in India.
 
• This championship took place in **March 2025**, focusing on the categories of **Senior, U-21, and Para Karate athletes**.
 
• **Ahmedabad**, located in the state of **Gujarat**, was chosen as the host city for the championship due to its excellent infrastructure and support for sports events. *Hence, the correct answer is Ahmedabad.*
 
• The event serves as a platform for athletes to showcase their skills and compete at a **national level**, promoting Karate as a sport in India.
 
• The championship aims to identify and nurture talent, encouraging participation in **international tournaments** such as the Asian Games and the Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ahmedabad:**

 
 
• **Ahmedabad** is one of the largest cities in **Gujarat**, known for its vibrant culture and history.
 
• The city has a history of hosting **major sporting events**, including cricket matches, Kabaddi championships, and other regional and national tournaments.
 
• Ahmedabad is equipped with **world-class sports infrastructure**, such as the Narendra Modi Stadium, making it a suitable choice for hosting events like the **Karate Championship**.
 
 
 
• **Karate India Organization (KIO):**
 
 
• **KIO** is the official body responsible for promoting Karate in India. It organizes **national-level championships** to encourage athletes and develop the sport.
 
• The organization works toward providing opportunities for Indian Karate athletes to participate in **international events**, including the World Karate Federation (WKF) tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Categories in the Championship:**
 
 
• The championship included **Senior, U-21, and Para categories**, ensuring inclusivity and representation of diverse athletes.
 
• The **Para category** promotes participation among athletes with disabilities, encouraging equal opportunities in sports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Karate Championships:**

 
 
• These championships are conducted annually and provide athletes with a **platform to compete at the highest level** within India.
 
• It helps in the selection of athletes for **international tournaments**, including the **Asian Games, Commonwealth Games,** and **Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Sports Events:**
 
 
• Such events contribute to the **development of sports infrastructure** and encourage local talent to participate.
 
• They also promote **sports tourism**, boosting the economy of the host city.
